> [!NOTE] > ## Other AI code review bot(s) detected > > CodeRabbit has detected other AI code review bot(s) in this pull request and will avoid duplicating their findings in the review comments. This may lead to a less comprehensive review. ## Walkthrough Per-entry listing callbacks were changed from returning bool to returning (bool, error) across filer core, stores, wrappers, server streams, mounts and tests; implementations now capture, wrap and propagate callback errors, and several stores also surface iterator/close errors. ## Changes | Cohort / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **Callback Type Definition**
`weed/filer/filerstore.go` | `ListEachEntryFunc` signature changed from `func(*Entry) bool` → `func(*Entry) (bool, error)`. | | **Filer Core & Search**
`weed/filer/filer.go`, `weed/filer/filer_search.go` | Traversal and matching updated to use `(bool, error)` callbacks; context-cancel and expired-entry branches adjusted; callback errors are propagated. | | **Wrappers & Path Translation**
`weed/filer/filerstore_wrapper.go`, `weed/filer/filerstore_translate_path.go` | Wrapper and path-translation closures updated to accept/propagate `(bool, error)`; prefix filtering wraps and propagates callback errors. | | **Server / gRPC**
`weed/server/filer_grpc_server.go`, `weed/server/filer_grpc_server_traverse_meta.go` | Stream listing callbacks updated to `(bool, error)`; `stream.Send` failures and limit conditions now return and propagate `(false, err)`/`(false, nil)`. | | **Mount / Directory Read**
`weed/mount/weedfs_dir_read.go`, `weed/mount/meta_cache/meta_cache.go` | `processEachEntryFn` and ListDirectoryEntries usages updated to `(bool, error)`; readdir and early-termination logic adjusted; imports updated. | | **Tests**
`weed/filer/store_test/test_suite.go`, `test/foundationdb/*`, `weed/filer/foundationdb/*` | Test callbacks updated to return `(bool, error)` (e.g., `return true, nil`); imports adjusted to support new error handling. | | **Abstract / SQL-like Stores**
`weed/filer/abstract_sql/...`, `weed/filer/arangodb/arangodb_store.go` | Per-entry callbacks now return `(bool, error)`; implementations capture values, wrap callback errors and stop iteration on error or false. | | **Cassandra / Cursored Stores**
`weed/filer/cassandra/...`, `weed/filer/cassandra2/...`, `weed/filer/mongodb/*` | Capture `(bool, error)` from callbacks; log and break on callback errors; propagate iterator/cursor Close() errors when present. | | **Redis Variants**
`weed/filer/redis/*`, `weed/filer/redis2/*`, `weed/filer/redis3/*`, `weed/filer/redis_lua/*` | Per-entry callbacks return `(bool, error)`; errors wrapped and iteration stops on error or false; some variants aggregate callback errors for return. | | **LevelDB / RocksDB / TiKV / YDB / Tarantool / Elastic**
`weed/filer/leveldb*`, `weed/filer/rocksdb/*`, `weed/filer/tikv/*`, `weed/filer/ydb/*`, `weed/filer/tarantool/*`, `weed/filer/elastic/*` | Per-entry callbacks treated as `(bool, error)`; callback errors wrapped and iteration halts on error or false; some stores propagate close/transaction errors. | | **Other store adaptors & imports**
`weed/filer/hbase/*`, `weed/filer/etcd/*`, `weed/filer/leveldb/*` | Import adjustments where needed and per-entry callback handling switched to `(bool, error)` with wrapped error messages on failures. | ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Caller as Caller (ReadDir / Server) participant Store as ListDirectoryEntries participant Each as eachEntryFunc Caller->>Store: ListDirectoryEntries(prefix, eachEntryFunc) Store->>Each: eachEntryFunc(entry) alt each returns true, nil Each-->>Store: true, nil Store->>Caller: continue iteration else each returns false, nil Each-->>Store: false, nil Store->>Caller: stop iteration (no error) else each returns , err Each-->>Store: , err Store->>Caller: wrap & propagate error and stop end Note right of Store: iterator/cursor Close() errors (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) are now checked and may be propagated ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes - Areas needing extra attention: - Global callback signature change impact across public/internal boundaries (`weed/filer/filerstore.go`, server streaming). - Consistent error wrapping/messages for callback errors across many store implementations. - Precedence and propagation of iterator/cursor Close()/transaction errors (Cassandra, MongoDB, cursored stores). - Mount ReadDir/ReadDirPlus and TTL/S3-expiry branches to ensure unchanged semantics. ## Possibly related PRs - seaweedfs/seaweedfs#7178 — Overlapping changes to filer per-entry listing callbacks and FoundationDB listing paths to the `(bool, error)` callback form. - seaweedfs/seaweedfs#7426 — Similar updates to ListDirectoryEntries/ListDirectoryPrefixedEntries and propagation of per-entry callback errors across stores. ## Poem > 🐇 I hopped through code with gentle care, > Callbacks now whisper errors fair. > I wrap them neat and stop the race, > No silent fails in listing’s place. > Hooray — I munch a bug with grace. ## Pre-merge checks and finishing touches
❌ Failed checks (2 warnings, 1 inconclusive) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :----------------: | :------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Description check | ⚠️ Warning | The PR description is incomplete, missing critical details about the solution approach and testing, with unchecked checklist items indicating no tests were added. | Complete the description by detailing how context termination errors are handled, explain the callback signature change throughout the codebase, and clarify testing approach. Check or remove unchecked checklist items. | | Docstring Coverage | ⚠️ Warning | Docstring coverage is 50.00% which is insufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. | You can run `@coderabbitai generate docstrings` to improve docstring coverage. | | Title check | ❓ Inconclusive | The PR title 'Add error list each entry func' is vague and uses non-descriptive phrasing that doesn't clearly convey the core change being made. | Revise the title to be more specific and descriptive of the actual implementation, such as 'Change ListEachEntryFunc callback to return (bool, error) for error propagation' or similar. |

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

## Summary of Changes Hello @tam-i13, I'm Gemini Code Assist[^1]! I'm currently reviewing this pull request and will post my feedback shortly. In the meantime, here's a summary to help you and other reviewers quickly get up to speed! This pull request introduces a significant refactoring to the directory listing callback mechanism within the filer service. The primary goal is to enhance error handling by modifying the `ListEachEntryFunc` signature to allow callbacks to return an error, in addition to a boolean indicating whether to continue processing. This change addresses the limitation of not being able to propagate errors encountered during the iteration of directory entries, particularly in scenarios like context termination. By implementing this across various storage backends and related components, the system gains improved reliability and more explicit error reporting during file system operations. ### Highlights * **Callback Signature Change**: The `ListEachEntryFunc` type, used for iterating over directory entries, has been updated to return both a boolean (to continue iteration) and an error. Previously, it only returned a boolean. * **Error Propagation**: This change enables proper error propagation from within the `eachEntryFunc` callback, allowing the system to detect and handle errors (such as context termination) that occur during the processing of individual entries. * **Widespread Adoption**: The updated callback signature and corresponding error handling have been consistently applied across all filer store implementations (e.g., SQL, ArangoDB, Cassandra, etcd, LevelDB, MongoDB, Redis, Hbase) and related components, ensuring robust error management throughout the directory listing process. * **Context Termination Handling**: Specific improvements have been made to handle context termination errors within the `filer.go` and other store implementations, ensuring that listing operations gracefully exit and report errors when the context is cancelled.
Using Gemini Code Assist
The full guide for Gemini Code Assist can be found on our [documentation page](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-github-code), here are some quick tips. Invoking Gemini You can request assistance from Gemini at any point by creating a comment using either `/gemini ` or `@gemini-code-assist `. Below is a summary of the supported commands on the current page. Feature | Command | Description --- | --- | --- Code Review | `/gemini review` | Performs a code review for the current pull request in its current state. Pull Request Summary | `/gemini summary` | Provides a summary of the current pull request in its current state. Comment | @gemini-code-assist | Responds in comments when explicitly tagged, both in pull request comments and review comments. Help | `/gemini help` | Displays a list of available commands. Customization To customize Gemini Code Assist for GitHub experience, repository maintainers can create a configuration file and/or provide a custom code review style guide (such as PEP-8 for Python) by creating and adding files to a `.gemini/` folder in the base of the repository. Detailed instructions can be found [here](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/customize-gemini-behavior-github). Limitations & Feedback Gemini Code Assist may make mistakes. Please leave feedback on any instances where its feedback is incorrect or counter productive. You can react with :thumbsup: and :thumbsdown: on @gemini-code-assist comments. If you're interested in giving your feedback about your experience with Gemini Code Assist for Github and other Google products, sign up [here](https://google.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_2cyuGuTWsEw84yG). You can also get AI-powered code generation, chat, as well as code reviews directly in the IDE at no cost with the [Gemini Code Assist IDE Extension](https://cloud.google.com/products/gemini/code-assist).
[^1]: Review the [Privacy Notices](https://policies.google.com/privacy), [Generative AI Prohibited Use Policy](https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy), [Terms of Service](https://policies.google.com/terms), and learn how to configure Gemini Code Assist in GitHub [here](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/customize-gemini-behavior-github). Gemini can make mistakes, so double check it and [use code with caution](https://support.google.com/legal/answer/13505487).
